_comment: Per-machine settings for the portable skills (installed to ~/.claude/setup.json on this Windows PC). Missing keys fall back to defaults: python3, ~/.claude/retros, no notes repo, no setup repo.

plugins._comment: Personal marketplace plugins for this PC only (shared ones are PLUGINS in scripts/setup_lib.py). marketplaces: name -> GitHub owner/repo, added with `claude plugin marketplace add` when missing.

basic_memory_writer._comment: The only basic-memory process that watches the vault (one watcher per session raced on search_vector_chunks). Runs hidden at logon as a Task Scheduler task, localhost only. Readers above have AUTO_UPDATE off because its save would write their INDEX_CHANGES=false into config.json; run `bm update` by hand.
